court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
case_name: Poongkodi v. Ashok alias G.Ashokan — C.M.A.No.1333 of 2020
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The respondent filed for divorce on the ground of cruelty under Section 13(1)(i-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The appellant did not allow the respondent to cohabit and threatened him that if he attempts, she will give complaint of rape against him and his family members.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that the appellant has given a false complaint.
legal_principles.held: The respondent did not examine his father, mother or his brothers to prove that the appellant has given false complaint against him.

legal_principles.principle: A wife will not make an allegation against her husband having illicit marital relationship with his elder brother's wife unless the same is proved.
legal_principles.held: No wife will make allegation against her husband having illicit marital relationship with his elder brother's wife, unless the same is proved.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's order and decree dated 27.07.2020 were set aside and the appeal was allowed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
